profile.headline: Software Engineer Associate @ Booz Allen Hamilton | Python, Java, C/C++, SQL
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer who works at the intersection of technology, clients, and outcomes.

In my role, I partner closely with non-technical and technical stakeholders to translate complex systems into clear, actionable solutions that support real-world use cases.

My work often involves leading technical discussions, aligning requirements across teams, and communicating tradeoffs in a way that builds trust and momentum. I enjoy environments where collaboration, problem-solving, and impact matter more than rigid silos.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.locationName: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
positions.description:
Developed stacking regression model from AIS data to predict a vessels path, direction, and speed; used to generate real time alerts of vessels approaching geo zone and conducting suspicious activity to reduce threat 
Created areas around vessels at various coordinates and timestamps using shapely and track vessels whom crossed into each other’s zones at similar time period; give reports of suspicious vessels congregating outside of the geo zone

honors.title: Distinguished Young Professional
honors.description:
The Distinguished Young Professional Award recognizes and rewards exceptional performance in four areas: leadership and guidance for the Emerging Leader program; superior technical achievement in the professional arena; a record of going "above and beyond" at the local AFCEA chapter or region level; and mentoring provided for other Emerging Leaders. Nominees for this award are evaluated through September of the current year.

AFCEA's Regional Vice Presidents have the honor of personally selecting an individual from their region to receive the Regional Distinguished Young Professional Award. These honorees represent an elite group of individuals, and one of them is voted Distinguished Young Professional of the Year.

volunteerExperiences.description: At A's for Aces, I worked with the children in the classroom before practice to help them complete assignments and study. At the end of my time here I developed a points chart to help keep track of behavior, encourage good behavior, and receive rewards.

As a student planning committee member, I was my schools' ambassador for Relay For Life. I helped make announcements, worked directly with teams, and helped run informational meetings. As a Captain, my team raised over $5,000 at our best year and was effective with spreading awareness. I also worked to create ideas to recognize fundraisers and teams. I also worked with nearby pizza vendors to negotiate prices to sell pizzas at the event and donate the rest towards the event.
